## 中文

- **AI 匹配**显示本轮进度和实际完成的结果，支持单独复评岗位。撤销进展后会保留面试复盘，仍在招的岗位可重新匹配。
- **切页后接着做。** 简历和求职草稿会保留，进行中的任务可以在页签上看到。AI 改稿结果会回到对应的简历版本。
- **Tab 补全可单独关闭。** 设置在「来源与同步 → 模型」。预填和恢复的草稿会留在本地，直到你主动发送。
- **在 DSH 里继续岗位背调。** 可带着岗位信息和待核查问题打开对话，也可以复制提示词。公司标志按需加载。

## English

- **AI Match** shows batch progress and how many results were saved. Reassess an individual role, or undo application progress while keeping interview notes so an open role can return to matching.
- **Pick up where you left off.** Résumé and job-search drafts stay in place as you switch tabs. See running tasks in the tab bar, and get AI edits in the résumé version you were working on.
- **Turn off Tab autocomplete on its own** in Sources & Sync → Models. Prefilled and restored drafts stay local until you send them.
- **Research a role in DSH** with its details and questions ready, or copy the prompt to use later. Company logos load on demand.
